name: vennix-storefront
description: Vennix — storefront, admin back office and Shopify Online Store 2.0 theme. Zero runtime dependencies.

scripts.reset: node -e "const s=require('./lib/seed'); s.seed(); console.log('store reset: catalog, orders, customers and content rebuilt')"
scripts.check: node --check server.js && node -e "require('./lib/store');require('./lib/seed');require('./lib/auth');require('./lib/cart');require('./lib/commerce');require('./lib/emails');require('./lib/ui');require('./lib/layout');require('./lib/api');require('./lib/admin/router');require('./lib/pages/home');require('./lib/pages/catalog');require('./lib/pages/product');require('./lib/pages/cart');require('./lib/pages/checkout');require('./lib/pages/account');require('./lib/pages/content');console.log('all modules load cleanly')"
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run check:render && npm run theme:check && npm run smoke && npm run features && npm run links && npm run browser:test
